title: Navbar loads on landing page and logo returns to hero section
description: Verifies the sticky navbar is present on the landing page and clicking the logo brings the user back to the hero area on the same page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page
Click the ARGUS logo
Verify the hero section is displayed

title: Navbar Dashboard link navigates to debate dashboard
description: Verifies the Dashboard navigation from the landing navbar takes the user to the debate dashboard page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the dashboard navigation link
Verify the user lands on the debate dashboard
Verify the debate topic input area is displayed

title: Clicking a non-existent navbar link does not change navigation
description: Verifies that interacting with a non-existent navbar link does not navigate away from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a non-existent navigation link in the navbar
Verify the user remains on the landing page
Verify the hero section is displayed

title: Hero section loads and agent intro CTA navigates to dashboard
description: Verifies the hero section is visible and the agent introduction CTA card navigates to the debate dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the hero section content
Scroll down the page
Click the agent intro CTA card
Verify the user lands on the debate dashboard

title: Hero CTA unresponsive click keeps user on landing page
description: Verifies that clicking an unresponsive CTA in the hero does not navigate away from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the hero section content
Scroll down the page
Click a CTA in the hero section that does not navigate
Verify the user remains on the landing page
Verify the hero section is displayed

title: How It Works section shows three role cards
description: Verifies the How It Works section is reachable and displays three feature cards describing the debate roles.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the How It Works section
Verify three role feature cards are displayed
Verify role explanation content is displayed on the cards

title: Clicking a How It Works card does not open expanded details
description: Verifies that clicking a How It Works feature card does not open an expanded detail panel when none exists.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the How It Works section
Click a How It Works feature card
Verify no expanded detail panel is displayed
Verify the How It Works cards remain displayed

title: Results & Verdict section displays scoring table and winner declaration
description: Verifies the Results & Verdict section can be reached and shows a scoring table and a winner outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Results section
Verify a scoring table with agent scores is displayed
Verify a winner declaration is displayed

title: Results & Verdict demo values remain consistent after revisiting the section
description: Verifies the Results & Verdict section uses static demo scores/verdict by confirming values do not change after leaving and returning to the section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Results section
Record the displayed score values and winner outcome shown in the Results section
Scroll away from the Results section to a different section of the page
Scroll back to the Results section
Verify the score values and winner outcome match the values previously recorded

title: Results & Verdict section remains readable after page refresh
description: Verifies the Results & Verdict section content is still present after reloading the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Results section
Refresh the page
Scroll to the Results section
Verify a scoring table with agent scores is displayed
Verify a winner declaration is displayed

title: Debate In Action section displays feature highlight cards
description: Verifies the Debate In Action section can be reached and shows feature highlight cards for product capabilities.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Debate in Action section
Verify feature highlight cards are displayed
Verify cards describing real-time generation and fallacy detection are displayed

title: Export feature interaction does not trigger a download flow
description: Verifies clicking the Export-related feature does not result in any downloadable/exported output within the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Debate in Action section
Click the Export feature highlight
Verify no download or export output is initiated in the UI
Verify the user remains on the landing page

title: Debate In Action section remains stable after repeated scrolling
description: Verifies the Debate In Action cards continue to display after moving away and back, indicating stable render behavior.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Debate in Action section
Scroll away to another section of the page
Scroll back to the Debate in Action section
Verify feature highlight cards are displayed

title: Models Supported tab filters the model grid
description: Verifies selecting a model tab updates the displayed model cards to match the selected filter.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Models Supported section
Click a model tab (for example, GPT-4o)
Verify the model grid updates to show cards matching the selected tab
Verify model cards are displayed in the filtered grid

title: Models Supported shows a clear state when filtering yields no results or placeholder content
description: Verifies the UI provides an observable outcome when a tab selection cannot populate the grid (empty/placeholder state).

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Models Supported section
Click multiple different model tabs one after another
Verify the UI provides a clear outcome for the selected tab, such as filtered cards or an empty/placeholder state message

title: Models Supported tab selection persists while staying on the section
description: Verifies that after selecting a tab, the filtered grid remains consistent while the user continues interacting within the same section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Models Supported section
Click a model tab
Scroll slightly within the page and then return focus to the Models Supported section
Verify the model grid still reflects the currently selected tab

title: Agent Face-Off section displays performance stats
description: Verifies the Agent Face-Off section on the landing page loads and shows agent performance stats after scrolling.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Agent Face-Off section
Verify agent performance stats are displayed
Verify cinematic agent visuals are displayed

title: Agent Face-Off stats do not appear outdated or static error state
description: Verifies the Agent Face-Off section does not show an error state implying stats are static or outdated.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Agent Face-Off section
Verify no outdated or static-data error message is visible

Scroll to the footer

Verify a final call-to-action is displayed

Scroll to the footer

Verify sidebar navigation items are displayed

Click the Active Debates nav item
Verify Active Debates is highlighted as the selected item

description: Verifies the dashboard sidebar back control navigates from the debate dashboard to the landing page.

Click the Main Landing back button
Verify the user lands on the landing page
Verify the landing page primary content is displayed

title: Debate History nav item is non-functional (no view change)
description: Verifies clicking Debate History does not change the current dashboard view, matching the documented non-functional behavior.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Click the Active Debates nav item
Click the Debate History nav item
Verify the dashboard remains on the Active Debates view

title: Arena Header shows INITIALIZING state on dashboard load
description: Verifies the arena header loads with the pre-debate INITIALIZING state.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the arena header shows the INITIALIZING state

title: Arena Header switches to ARENA ACTIVE after starting a debate
description: Verifies starting a debate updates the arena header status to active.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Submit the start debate action
Verify the arena header shows the ARENA ACTIVE state

title: Start a debate via button and see debate thread populate
description: Verifies a user can start a debate and see both agents' arguments appear in the thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the dashboard is in an awaiting-parameters state
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Click the start debate control
Verify the debate thread shows arguments from both agents

title: Start a debate via Enter key and see debate thread populate
description: Verifies pressing Enter in the topic input starts the debate and renders the thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Press Enter
Verify the debate thread shows arguments from both agents

title: Empty topic does not start a debate
description: Verifies the debate does not start when the input is empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Clear the debate topic input field
Click the start debate control
Verify no debate thread appears

title: Request ML Verdict opens Judge-0 modal and Accept closes it
description: Verifies the Judge-0 verdict modal opens after starting a debate and can be closed via accepting the verdict.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Submit the start debate action
Click the request ML verdict control
Verify the Judge-0 verdict modal is displayed
Click the accept verdict control
Verify the Judge-0 verdict modal is not displayed

title: Judge-0 modal shows logic scores and fallacy flags
description: Verifies the verdict modal contains the expected score and fallacy sections for both agents.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Submit the start debate action
Click the request ML verdict control
Verify logic scores are displayed for both agents
Verify fallacy flags are displayed for both agents

title: Close Judge-0 modal using the close icon
description: Verifies the verdict modal can be dismissed using the close icon.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Submit the start debate action
Click the request ML verdict control
Click the modal close icon
Verify the Judge-0 verdict modal is not displayed

title: Close Judge-0 modal by clicking the backdrop
description: Verifies the verdict modal can be dismissed by clicking outside the modal content.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Fill a debate topic into the input field
Submit the start debate action
Click the request ML verdict control
Click the backdrop outside the modal content
Verify the Judge-0 verdict modal is not displayed
